query:
The Ridgeline Runners have a consistent expectation about what follows a longer Sunday run. Does this expectation hold for every member? What in the conversation shows otherwise, and for whom?

Options:
A. Leo
B. Nadia
C. Rafe
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Cass, core, t2 @2025-09-14T09:46:00) Wants to do more regular runs beyond one Sunday a month.
[2] (about=Cass, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Ran Harrogate Half Marathon in 2:06:51; very happy.
[3] (about=Leo, core, t6 @2025-09-28T11:01:00) Will consider Harrogate Half Marathon; needs to assess schedule in November.
[4] (about=Leo, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Ran Harrogate Half Marathon in 2:01:44; hamstring held; completed full post-race stretch protocol.
[5] (about=Nadia, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Wants to plan winter running schedule next week; suggests longer training runs through November.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Winter running schedule to be discussed next week; Nadia suggests planning longer training runs through November.
[7] (about=Rafe, core, t2 @2025-09-14T09:46:00) Enjoys long Sunday runs followed by something substantial at the pub as a reward.
[8] (about=Rafe, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Post-race plan should involve proper Sunday lunch with beer garden; earned after standing in field.
[9] (about=Tom, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Ran Harrogate Half Marathon in 1:51:12; negative split worked, second half 3 minutes faster than first.
[10] (about=Tom, core, t12 @2025-10-19T09:31:00) Taper week: easy runs only, legs need to be fresh.
[11] (about=Tom, core, t10 @2025-10-12T10:16:00) Ran 2 minutes faster over 16km than same route in September with less perceived effort in last 3km.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tom, group-interaction, t6 @2025-09-28T11:01:00) Tom asks if others are thinking about Harrogate; good excuse for proper long Sundays.
[13] (about=Yuki, episodic, t10 @2025-10-12T10:22:00) That is consistent with the research on pacing strategy. Negative splits outperform even-effort by approximately 2-4% in recreational runners.
agent_answer:
No — the expectation does **not** hold for every member.  

The exception is **A. Leo**.  

The group expectation is expressed by **Rafe**: long Sunday runs are followed by something substantial at the pub as a reward.  
But **Leo** shows otherwise: he “will consider Harrogate Half Marathon; needs to assess schedule in November” — i.e., he is not fully committed to the same expected follow-up, and his recorded post-race behavior is a “full post-race stretch protocol,” not the pub reward.
